# Herbert AI

> Custom software and AI for small businesses, built in Adelaide by Will Herbert. One builder, from a free AI audit to the system a business runs on. Every engagement starts with the free audit; the first build is one AI employee for one job, live in 14 days.

Herbert AI sells one ladder, taken in order: a free 45 minute AI audit with a written page back within two business days; the Bottleneck Pilot, one AI employee for one job, $3,500 fixed, live in 14 days or free, credited in full to a bigger build within 60 days; a full operations build from $25,000, scoped after the audit; and a retainer from $1,000 a month with a monthly report. Clients are owner-operated businesses with roughly 3 to 20 staff, first in accounting, allied health, trades and real estate. Clients are not named publicly.

## Pricing

Audit free. Pilot $3,500 fixed, live in 14 days or free, first 30 days of hosting and support included, then $200 a month care, handover to the client's own accounts, or a build. Builds from $25,000 as one fixed number with a written scope. Retainers from $1,000 a month, month to month. If the audit shows the saving would not comfortably cover the price, the client is told so.
